arms.group_weighted_utr_sg: fixed stratified collection + auto-lagged group-weighted actor PPO

candidate.lagged_score: preceding training rollout per-group mean absolute TD residual
candidate.failure_weight_normalization: frequency-weighted mean one across failure graphs
candidate.bootstrap: first update uses unit failure weights; each later update uses only immediately preceding rollout scores
candidate.runtime_persistence: lagged scores must be stored in and restored from strict runtime checkpoints

per_cohort_required: positive mean robust gain versus UTR
at least three of five nonnegative robust gains versus UTR
no additional catastrophic seed relative to Original DRTP
gain range and sample SD no larger than Original DRTP
mean robust endpoint retained within epsilon_J of Original DRTP
upper-tail Original-DRTP seeds retained within epsilon_J
no safety metric exceeds frozen limit relative to paired UTR
fixed sampler and auto-lagged weight integrity
gate.decision_rule: C2_EARLY_GO only if Cohort A and Cohort B both pass separately. Any cohort failure is C2_NO_GO; pooled n=10 is descriptive only.
